# Security policy

Please do not report a security problem in a public issue.

- **Portable Hermes itself**: the installer, the updaters, the launchers, the
  desktop GUI and the portable tools in this repository. Use the
  **Report a vulnerability** button on this repository's **Security** tab. The
  report stays private between you and the maintainers.
- **The Hermes Agent core**: everything that comes from
  [NousResearch/hermes-agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent),
  which Portable Hermes downloads when it installs or updates the core. Report
  it to that project, as its own security policy describes.

If you are not sure which of the two is affected, report it here.
